scientific_references.use: Two separate organelles are apposed and linked by illustrative tethers; mitochondrial membranes and ER lumen remain separate. Concepts only; no source artwork or geometry copied.

assets.scientific_limitations: No membrane fusion or obligatory named tether. Contact distance, calcium or lipid flux, physiological state and measured dynamics are not established.
